original_query: select  c_customer_id as customer_id        , coalesce(c_last_name,'') || ', ' || coalesce(c_first_name,'') as customername  from customer      ,customer_address      ,customer_demographics      ,household_demographics      ,income_band      ,store_returns  where ca_city	        =  'Hamilton'    and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk    and ib_lower_bound   >=  69245    and ib_upper_bound   <=  69245 + 50000    and ib_income_band_sk = hd_income_band_sk    and cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk    and hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk    and sr_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk  order by c_customer_id  limit 100;
